verdict.rationale: cubic documents auto-resolving threads, which closes findings once the issue is fixed (cubic-docs-20). Its Analytics API also tracks how many flagged issues were fixed (cubic-docs-16). Both imply it re-checks code after changes, but the evidence only states that new PRs are reviewed automatically (cubic-docs-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that new pushes trigger an incremental re-review of only the new commits, evidence that old comments are not repeated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
